title: Easy Chinese Pork Casserole
description: A simple and hearty Chinese-inspired casserole made with pork and noodles, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles, green onions, and water to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and bubbly.
